name: qoder-credit-watch
displayName: Qoder 多账号 Credits 余量监控
description: Read the remaining Qoder Credits of several accounts in one pass, each from its own signed-in browser profile, matching every number to the userId it came from, and view them on a local dashboard you open in the browser. Also tells you which account has not claimed today's daily bonus yet - it never claims for you. Stores no credentials.
descriptionZh: 一次查全多个账号的剩余 Credits：每个数字都从该号自己已登录的浏览器 Profile 里读取并按真实 userId 归档，并用本地服务在浏览器里打开余量看板。看板还会告诉你哪个号当天还没签到领每日奖励（只提醒，不代领）。插件不保存任何凭证。
